name: Whimsigoth
reacts_against: both traditional goth's severity and 2010s minimalism, mixing mysticism with a softer 1990s silhouette.

findings: dark — about 72% of the measured color across 6 wiki photos is below mid-lightness
mostly muted — about 57% of the measured color is low-saturation (greys, dusty tones)
measured.caveat: Colors measured from the Aesthetics Wiki images as photographed and displayed on screen; actual materials vary, and screen colors are approximate.
